description.en: Thin-film module on glass with a cadmium telluride absorber, monolithically series-connected. Reference: First Solar Series 7 TR1 (frameless, glass-glass, heat-strengthened glass).
description.es: Modulo de capa delgada sobre vidrio con absorbedor de teluro de cadmio, conectado en serie de forma monolitica. Referencia: First Solar Series 7 TR1 (sin marco, vidrio-vidrio, vidrio templado termicamente).

typical_use: Utility-scale modules with good high-temperature and low-light response; frameless.

cell.note: Datasheet: 'thin film CdTe semiconductor, up to 268 cells'. Individual cell size and CdTe layer thickness not stated (TR1, FT1 and NEPD).

layers.name: Front encapsulant
layers.material: laminate with edge seal (FT1 description); material and thickness not stated

layers.name: Rear encapsulant
layers.material: laminate with edge seal (FT1 description); material and thickness not stated

parts.name: Front encapsulant
parts.material: laminate with edge seal (FT1 description); not stated

parts.name: Rear encapsulant
parts.material: laminate with edge seal (FT1 description); not stated

parts.name: CdTe monolithic cell string (up to 268 cells)
Frame
parts.note: Frameless design; frame-to-glass bonded with silicone (see sealant part).

geometry.description: Footprint 2300 x 1216 mm, area 2.80 m2 (Series 7 TR1 datasheet). Module thickness, glass thickness and CdTe layer thickness not stated in any source reached; elements left empty rather than guessed. Dual junction box, frameless.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module long side, y along short side, z up through thickness; origin at module front-left corner; mm. Here z=0 is the front glass face and z grows toward the rear through thickness.

mechanical_ratings.status_note: values transcribed from cited datasheets only; status unverified unless marked
mechanical_ratings.weight_note: 38.46 to 39.7 kg (Series 7 TR1 datasheet); 36.8 kg (Series 7 FT1 datasheet and NEPD, India/USA)
mechanical_ratings.frameless_source: TR1: 'Frameless design improves soiling and snow shedding'; FT1: 'Frameless design improves soiling performance'

unverified_items: Module thickness, glass thickness, encapsulant and CdTe layer thickness not stated (TR1, FT1 and NEPD checked).
Encapsulant material and thickness not stated; FT1 says only 'laminate with edge seal'.
Cell count 'up to 268' is a datasheet upper bound, not confirmed for each bin.
Weight differs by model: 38.46-39.7 kg (TR1) vs 36.8 kg (FT1, NEPD). Both kept.
Cable length differs: 650 mm (TR1) vs 500 mm (FT1). Both kept as sourced; TR1 values in the cable part.
IEC 61701 is listed only as an extended test, not as a standalone certificate.
